data.name: Haris
data.gender_notes: Haris is used as a male name in islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Arabic root ح-ر-س (ḥ-r-s), 'to guard'. Ḥāris means 'guardian'. Its root is ح-ر-س (ḥ-r-s). A common Muslim given name. Haris is a Arabic name meaning “Guardian; protector; cultivator”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Haris expresses “Guardian; protector; cultivator”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Arabic root ح-ر-س (ḥ-r-s), 'to guard'. Ḥāris means 'guardian'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Haris total 28, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
